mapper.select: /* PlatformLocationMapper.selectRecentPlatformSmsSendCnt */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S WHERE 1=1 AND S.MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.INSERT_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)

/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectPlatformCertSmsId */ SELECT S.SMS_ID FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S WHERE 1=1 AND S.MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND S.AUTH_CD = #{certNo} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.EXPIRED_AT >= NOW() AND S.VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND S.FAIL_CNT < 5 ORDER BY S.SMS_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* PlatformLocationMapper.increasePlatformSmsFailCnt */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET FAIL_CNT = FAIL_CNT + 1 WHERE 1=1 AND MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SMS_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: /* PlatformLocationMapper.selectPlatformSmsVerified */ SELECT S.SMS_ID AS smsId , DATE_FORMAT(S.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS verifiedAt , TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), DATE_ADD(S.UPDATE_DATE, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS remainSec FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.MBL_NO_HMAC = S.MBL_NO_HMAC WHERE 1=1 AND U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND S.PURPOSE_CD = 'PLATFORM_LOCATION' AND S.VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND S.UPDATE_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY S.UPDATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectLocationSiteList */ SELECT S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NO AS siteNo , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm , S.LAT AS lat , S.LON AS lon , S.GPS_RANGE AS gpsRange FROM TB_SITE S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY S.SITE_CD ASC

/* PlatformLocationMapper.selectGpsList */ SELECT 'ATTD' AS srcType , G.USER_CD AS userCd , G.API_CALL_TIME AS measureTime , G.GPS_INFO_TYPE AS gpsInfoType , G.LAT_ENC AS latEnc , G.LON_ENC AS lonEnc , G.LAT AS lat , G.LON AS lon , G.ACCURACY AS accuracy , G.IS_MOCKED AS mockedYn , G.IP_ADDR AS ipAddr FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND G.API_CALL_DATE = #{date} UNION ALL SELECT 'TBM' AS srcType , A.USER_CD AS userCd , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENTRY_AT, '%H%i%s') AS measureTime , NULL AS gpsInfoType , A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT_ENC AS latEnc , A.ENTRY_GPS_LON_ENC AS lonEnc , A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT AS lat , A.ENTRY_GPS_LON AS lon , NULL AS accuracy , 'N' AS mockedYn , NULL AS ipAddr FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE A INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON S.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT IS NOT NULL OR A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL) AND DATE_FORMAT(A.ENTRY_AT, '%Y%m%d') = #{date} ORDER BY measureTime ASC LIMIT 1001
